title: From the Archives: Open Mic, September 2023
html:
Among my many disjointed and unrelated side quests is music.

Labeling myself as a musician always felt strange to me, and it still does. It wasn’t until I had been playing guitar for something like five years that I didn’t squirm when someone called me a guitar player. I was someone who could play guitar. But a guitarist?! I didn’t feel worthy of the title. A strange but true fact is that our felt sense of identity seems to lag behind reality. That is, of course, unless you are “delulu.” But that’s a topic for another time :).

Anywho…

Back in September 2023, I met this girl named Karinthia at an open mic.

A few unimportant details later, we decided to play together at a future open mic (the one in the video).

We agreed on the songs, said we would show up with them learned, and just… sent it.

Our baby set list included:

  • What Was I Made For? — Billie Eilish

  • Valerie — Amy Winehouse

First take. No rehearsal.

Karinthia killed it 👏!!

And a special shoutout to the dude in the back shouting, “I got to witness that!”

Hope you find this at least a little entertaining!

P.S.: Yes, those are camo Crocs.
